access_pathway_details.text: Baclocur (baclofen) holds a French marketing authorisation (22 Oct 2018) to reduce alcohol consumption in adults with alcohol dependence, after failure of other available drug treatments. The SmPC strongly recommends not exceeding 300 mg/day.

eligibility_requirements.text: Adults with alcohol dependence and high-risk drinking (>60 g/day for men, >40 g/day for women), after failure of other available drug treatments.

risk_notes.text: Abrupt withdrawal of baclofen can cause hallucinations and seizures; doses should be reduced gradually. No efficacy or safety data exist above 300 mg/day.

oversight_notes.text: Baclocur is a List I prescription-only medicine requiring particular monitoring during treatment.

cost_notes.text: Official price €10.04 (incl. dispensing fee) for 30 × 20 mg tablets; reimbursed at 15%. Monthly cost depends on dose.

arbitrage_summary.text: France: baclofen is authorised for reducing alcohol consumption (Baclocur), as a second-line treatment after other drug treatments fail.
